tagline: Lets the read-only secret-blast-radius credential inventory run without review, while its online and file-writing options stay reviewed.
summary: secret-blast-radius lists which credentials a malicious npm install could reach on a machine or CI runner and prints an ordered rotation plan. It never prints secret values and changes nothing. This extension marks its offline report invocations as safe to run; the opt-in --osv lookup (sends lockfile package names and versions to api.osv.dev) and --sarif-file/--runbook-file writes stay under review.
limitations: Only the listed offline report invocations are treated as safe; any other form, including a bare run with project directories, keeps review.
The extension classifies invocations; it does not verify the installed package or its findings.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
